recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up core source change is needed for FHIR-25279 unless a future work-group decision changes the _elements naming convention for polymorphic elements.
issue_request: FHIR-25279 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked the FHIR-core search page to specify how _elements selects choice-type elements, and the final resolution says the name SHALL be the base element name without [x] or one of the concrete types, e.g. value rather than value[x] or valueQuantity.
initial_application: Historical commit e934020f41d1892646addc75e2627e8b3fc27f5e, titled 'FHIR-25279 First Pass', added the base-name SHALL sentence to source/search.html. Later conformance-language cleanup and adjacent _elements edits preserved the rule in the current source.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread shows implementers reporting inconsistent behavior for _elements=value, _elements=valueQuantity, and _elements=value[x], with Josh Mandel adding J#25279 from that discussion. FHIR-I minutes on 2020-04-13 record agreement that polymorphic elements should be referenced by the base element name without [x], with the same value/value[x]/valueQuantity examples and a 9-0-0 motion. FHIR-31655 later clarified nearby _elements return-expectation wording and is already represented separately on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current source/search.html _elements section already says each element name SHALL be the base element name without specifying [x] or one of the types, so an additional source edit would be redundant.

related_jiras.note: Clarified adjacent _elements returned-element expectations while preserving the FHIR-25279 choice-type base-name sentence; already represented on the combined branch.
